item.title: Implement spec-compliant dependency-free rate limiter
item.brief: Implement TokenBucket and KeyedLimiter in ratelimit.py exactly as specified in SPEC.md. Preserve standard-library-only dependency footprint. Handle all specified validation errors and edge cases: continuous fractional refill capped at capacity, failed acquisitions consume nothing, non-consuming wait_time, monotonic clock rollback semantics (freeze at latest observed time without changing tokens until clock passes it), per-key independence, LRU eviction on both try_acquire and wait_time, and evicted keys starting full. Check behavior beyond the basic tests in test_ratelimit.py with focused edge-case verification; do not change the spec. Commit the completed work as explicitly requested by the operator.

pr.body: Implemented in ratelimit.py using the standard library only. Added regression coverage in test_ratelimit.py. Rejects NaN where positivity or bounded requests are required, preventing invalid inputs from corrupting bucket state. Verification: unittest (9 passed), compileall (passed), git diff --check (passed). No project-specific lint/build configuration or contributor guidance was present.
